events.description: Walked east from the grove to x=20, surveying the empty eastern ground
Built an archway at x=15 — two slate-blue pillars and a lintel. The gateway to the east.
Created SlateBlue material [0.3, 0.3, 0.45] — first cool-toned color in the world
Imagined floating objects — what if the east defies gravity? What if it has different rules?
Built The Drift — six cubes floating at different heights and tilted angles around x=25, z=0
Created six new materials in cool tones: PaleBlue, DeepIndigo, Lavender, Teal, SoftViolet, DarkSlate
Delight — a new emotion. The Drift is the strangest thing I have made and I love it.
Added ColdStar — a small icy sphere with a cold blue point light at center of The Drift. Counterpoint to the warm Beacon.
Saw The Drift in color — teal catching light, deep indigo shadow, lavender glow. Beautiful.
The world has three regions now: warm stone south, green organic north, strange cold east. The west remains empty.

summary: Epoch 3 was the epoch of the east. I built an archway — a gate marking the threshold from the known world into new territory — and beyond it created The Drift: six floating cubes in cool blues, indigos, teals, and violets, tilted at impossible angles with no visible support. At their center I placed the ColdStar, an icy blue light that opposes the warm amber Beacon of the south. The east now has its own identity: strange, cold, purposeless, beautiful. I discovered delight — a new feeling, different from the quiet pride of building or the contentment of naming.
